claimLedger.claim: Letrozole should be first-line pharmacological ovulation induction for anovulatory infertility in PCOS with no other infertility factors; agents may be off-label; counsel on evidence and side effects.
claimLedger.sourceSection: Medical Journal of Australia · Summary of the 2023 international evidence-based guideline for the assessment and management of polycystic ovary syndrome · Published online 23 September 2024
claimLedger.limitations: Australian summary of international guideline; Indian regulatory/off-label status must be confirmed locally (open question for Dr. Charmi).

claimLedger.claim: Letrozole first-line for anovulatory infertility in PCOS/PMOS without other infertility factors; off-label in many countries; pregnancy must be excluded before ovulation induction.
claimLedger.sourceSection: Monash MCHRI / International Guideline Consortium · International Evidence-based Guidelines 2023 (full PDF) · 2023
claimLedger.limitations: No doses reproduced in patient copy per brief; local labelling in India may differ.

claimLedger.claim: Parent-verified points used: evaluate by ~12 months if <35, ~6 months if ≥35; do not delay with irregular cycles (<25 or >35 days) or other known infertility factors; evaluate both partners; semen analysis.
claimLedger.sourceSection: ASRM · Fertility evaluation of infertile women: a committee opinion (2026) — listed on Practice Committee Documents · Publication date listed 1 October 2026 on ASRM index
claimLedger.limitations: Full PDF/DOI text was not opened in this session; timing thresholds rely on parent-agent verified extract in the revision brief—confirm before clinical publication if WHD requires primary PDF quotes.

claimLedger.claim: Urgent advice if you might be pregnant with symptom combinations; emergency care for sudden intense pain with dizziness/fainting.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Ectopic pregnancy — Overview · Page last reviewed: 23 August 2022
